subject.title: fix(logging): narrow STRUCTURED_APP_PASSWORD_FIELD_RE to Apple/iCloud-specific fields

question: Should generic text/error/detail fields redact app-password-shaped values only when Apple/iCloud/app-password context is present, or should OpenClaw require a stricter fail-closed, dictionary, or per-token proximity design before merge?
rationale: The patch intentionally reduces masking in generic persisted fields to stop content corruption, but that changes when credential-shaped values are protected in logs, audits, and transcripts.

options.title: Accept Context-Gated Generic Redaction
options.body: After the transcript-test contradiction is fixed and live proof is supplied, merge this focused approach and accept that no-context generic app-password-shaped values may remain visible to preserve ordinary kebab identifiers.

options.title: Require Per-Token Or Proximity Context
options.body: Ask for a tighter token-near-context gate if maintainers want to reduce mixed-field false positives before accepting weaker generic-field masking.

options.title: Use The Broader Sibling Design
options.body: Pause this PR and choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94256 only if maintainers prefer its larger hybrid design after its conflicts and proof state are resolved.

recommendation.title: Accept Context-Gated Generic Redaction
recommendation.body: After the transcript-test contradiction is fixed and live proof is supplied, merge this focused approach and accept that no-context generic app-password-shaped values may remain visible to preserve ordinary kebab identifiers.
